Chapter 1097: 24 The Seventh Physical Body Divine Ability (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1097: Chapter 24 The Seventh Physical Body Divine Ability (Seeking Subscription)

“Galaxy?”

The young man in the black robe couldn’t believe it.

He and the Ancient Ming Venerable had speculated a lot about this ‘Galaxy’, mostly believing that he was a Great Saint reincarnated.

However, even if one were a Great Saint reincarnated, cultivating without bottlenecks or hindrances, a millennium ago, ‘Galaxy’ was not even at the Chaos Realm.

Has he suddenly returned to the peak of the Chaos Realm in just a thousand years?

“I once descended a consciousness remotely and vaguely felt that the existence swallowing Chaos Qi seemed familiar. It happened in the nearby Void Domain…”

Ancient Ming Venerable said.

The number of powerhouses at the peak of the Chaos Realm is rare, often only one or two in a Void Domain, and spectacle lifeforms at the Chaos Realm are even rarer.

Ancient Ming Venerable doubted it was such a coincidence that a Chaos Realm peak powerhouse happened to be swallowing Chaos Qi nearby.

Moreover, this Chaos Realm peak gave him a sense of familiarity.

“Thinking about it carefully, it’s very possible indeed.”

The young man in the black robe pondered for a moment and started to agree internally.

Although it seems unbelievable to reach the peak of the Chaos Realm in just over a thousand years,

for a power at the level of a Great Saint, one cannot simply reason rationally.

The so-called logic and common sense are meant to be broken by the reincarnation of a Great Saint.

Moreover, in his eyes, ‘Galaxy’ is definitely not a simple Chaos Great Saint, likely an unparalleled Great Saint above ordinary Great Saints.

“They say a Great Saint reincarnated cultivates at an unbelievable speed, but now it seems it’s more than that…”

Ancient Ming Venerable sighed from the heart.

He didn’t know how much effort and chance it took him to cultivate to the Chaos Realm.

Even so, he is still some distance from the peak of the Chaos Realm.

The time required to cross this distance, even without encountering any bottleneck, would be calculated in Cosmic Eras.

“What do we do now?”

The young man in the black robe thought for a moment and asked.

“If we didn’t know it would be fine, but now that we know, should we go pay our respects?” Ancient Ming Venerable cautiously suggested.

In the Chaos Void, no matter which Void Domain, ascending to the Chaos Realm from the peak of the Dominator Realm is an event that requires grand celebrations and is a good occasion to connect with other venerables.

Lin Yuan has quietly recovered to the Chaos Realm’s strength, although outsiders are unaware, Ancient Ming Venerable felt he should express something.

Previously, with this ‘Galaxy’ being a Great Saint reincarnated, Ancient Ming Venerable dared not visit for fear of arousing suspicion.

After all, given his strength, he could possibly pose a threat to the reincarnation of a Great Saint, even if he had no such intention, he had to consider whether the other party thought so.

Now, however, he no longer has this concern. Lin Yuan’s strength at the Chaos Realm peak, combined with the methods of a Great Saint, poses no threat to the Ancient Ming Venerable.

“Let’s go pay our respects now.”

Ancient Ming Venerable had made up his mind, feeling a sense of urgency.

…..

Star Tears ‘Fragment World’.

Lin Yuan was in the process of constructing an internal universe, which is part of cultivating the second level of “Infinite Void.”

The “Infinite Void” heritage, impacts the internal universe on a microcosmic level, adjusting the basic structure of the internal universe to make it more stable and perfect.

“Marvelous.”

“To think that changing this structure could increase the stability of the internal universe by sixty percent?”

“And replacing this part of the structure can make the rules and paths within the internal universe run much more smoothly…”

Lin Yuan immersed himself in the cultivation of “Infinite Void”, with the foundation of the first level, he efficiently progressed to the second level.

“The founder of this heritage, worthy of being a thirteenth-order time-being…”

Lin Yuan was amazed, as his understanding deepened, he appreciated the greatness of the founder.

In the Source World, Lin Yuan could occasionally glimpse the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, a thirteenth-order being.

But he had only seen it from afar, without coming into contact with the other’s Tao and methods.

The cultivators in the Source World leaned more toward bloodlines. The “Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method” passed down by the Ancestor, essentially condenses the Seed of the Fierce Sun to inherit the ancestral abilities.

“Mastering the second level of ‘Infinite Void’, I can suppress Chaos Realm peak venerables purely by relying on my internal universe.”

Lin Yuan contemplated.

As Lin Yuan delved deeper into his cultivation,

“Hmm?”

“Ancient Ming Venerable wants to pay his respects to me?”

Lin Yuan raised his eyebrow; the Xuanyuan Supreme had just sent him a message saying that Ancient Ming Venerable wished to visit.

“It seems he’s noticed something.”

Lin Yuan thought casually, during his breakthrough to the Dominator Realm, his voracious devouring of infinite Chaos Qi attracted the attention of many venerables.

At that time, with a cursory glance, Lin Yuan noticed that among those venerables was Ancient Ming Venerable.

The other venerables had never interacted with Lin Yuan, hence were clueless about the occasion of the Chaos Qi devourer, only understanding not to provoke it.

But Ancient Ming Venerable? Having interacted with Lin Yuan, a faint causal link between them made it possible for him to detect something given that Lin Yuan, now at the Dominator Realm, couldn’t fully mask his aura.

“Let him come in.”

Lin Yuan did not refuse.

Having stepped into the Dominator Realm, his strength rivaling the Chaos Realm peak, he confidently overlooked the prospect of facing a Great Saint.

He surely wouldn’t shy away from meeting Ancient Ming Venerable.

Additionally, Lin Yuan was quite curious as to why Ancient Ming Venerable sought his favor so frequently.
